nodes.label: Image
nodes.description: Decodes an approved embedded or bundled image and fits, transforms, and uploads it to a frame-sized transparent raster.

nodes.label: Split
nodes.description: Splits live text into character or word elements while preserving shaped positions.

params.description: Configures by for the Split node.

nodes.label: Boolean
nodes.description: Combines two vector inputs with union, subtraction, or intersection.

params.name: op
params.description: Configures op for the Boolean node.

nodes.label: Blur
nodes.description: Applies a separable Gaussian blur to a raster.

params.name: radius
params.description: Configures radius for the Blur node.

nodes.label: Dither
nodes.description: Applies ordered Bayer dithering with configurable quantization levels and cell scale.

params.description: Configures scale for the Dither node.

nodes.label: ASCII
nodes.description: Reconstructs a raster with cells sampled through a built-in ASCII glyph ramp.

nodes.label: Outline Text

nodes.description: Segments the foreground with the RMBG model and writes the mask into raster alpha.

nodes.label: Flatten
